editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: XM is a legitimate, CySEC/ASIC-regulated broker with 15+ years of operation and a $5 minimum deposit that genuinely removes the capital barrier. The Ultra Low account (0.6 pips, no commission) represents fair value in 2026, but the Standard account at 1.6 pips is overpriced against modern competition. Most global clients land on the FSC Belize offshore entity with zero compensation protection — and the 75.33% retail loss rate should make anyone reconsider trading at 1:1000 leverage. Withdrawals process cleanly for most traders within 24 hours, though polarised Trustpilot reviews (3.1/5) suggest the experience after signup does not match the marketing promise for everyone. A solid starting broker if you pick the right account type and treat the leverage as a loaded gun, not a feature.
